journey.name: Control a routine from the notification
journey.description: A user starts a routine, leaves the app, and pauses, resumes and skips it from the notification. Needs an emulator with System UI, not an ATD image.

actions.action: Verify a Ritune notification shows the current step with "Pause" and "Skip" buttons
Verify the Ritune notification shows "Paused" and a "Resume" button
Verify the Ritune notification shows step 2 of 4
Tap the body of the Ritune notification
Verify the Ritune player is shown on step 2 of 4
